source: ESPN final-score CSV archives; own Elo replay and fitted coefficients
method: Fixed 20-game histories and 10-game minimum. Train once on first three seasons; no fitting on validation or test. Ratings and history update after each Eastern date. Baselines: home margin 3 points and rolling team total.
limitations: Final-score model; possession statistics and roster/injury inputs not included.
Early games without sufficient history excluded.
Not connected to live scoring pending comparison with existing forecast and historical possession model.
